purpose: State a formal reason or an amount per unit.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
N + につき; quantity unit + につき
As we are closed today, we cannot answer calls.
Each person may buy up to two tickets.
Cleaning is in progress; please use another entrance.
formation: N + につき; quantity unit + につき
restrictions: The reason use means because of; the unit use means per.
mistake: Do not confuse it with topic marker について.
